meaning:
1) to rejoice
1a) (Qal) to rejoice
1b) (Niphal) to exult
1b1) to flap joyously (of ostrich)
1c) (Hithpael) to delight oneself

elsewhere.note: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.
Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
